H_hierarchical.evidence: The paper describes a flat FSM with six high-level states and per-state controllers, but no parent/child state nesting.

G_guards_arith.evidence: Transitions and branches use panel detection, eang < 0.05, elat sign, elat threshold AND distance < 0.5 m, combined elat/eang thresholds, and elong < 0.1 m.

A_actions_nontrivial.evidence: Per-state actions include rotate-to-search, PI heading and longitudinal control, time-based turn/forward maneuvers scaled by |k1*elat| and |k2*elat|, Replan backup, and motor stop.

F_fault_recovery.evidence: Dedicated recovery exists through Replan after misalignment near the trailer and a loss-of-LED path that stops motion and returns to Detect; no explicit from-any-state fault hierarchy.

T1_cross_section_element.evidence: State set, state variables, guards, and actions are concentrated in Section 3.2 around Figure 5, so no non-adjacent split is required.

T2_implicit_domain_term.evidence: Terms such as Replan and PI controller are accompanied by explicit behavior, so no hidden transition rule must be decoded from domain knowledge.

T3_implicit_action_from_prose.evidence: The state-action mapping is described immediately after the state list in the same control-strategy subsection.

T4_multivar_arith_guard.evidence: The Replan guard combines lateral-error threshold with distance-to-bunk-board condition; forward approach also requires both elat and eang within thresholds.

T5_composite_internal_behavior.evidence: No composite parent state has its own entry, during, or exit behavior; the FSM is flat.

T6_global_cross_cutting_recovery.evidence: Loss-of-panel and Replan are recovery paths, but the paper does not state an explicit from-any-state or N-state escape rule.

C1_speculative_dfs.evidence: No composite state or non-trivial initial pseudo-state chain is present.

C2_expr_ir_smt.evidence: The sample has composed guard patterns such as elat threshold AND distance < 0.5 m, plus combined elat/eang thresholds.

C3_forced_and_aspect.evidence: No explicit cross-cutting rule over at least three substates and no parent-level during monitor are specified.

C4_abstract_action.evidence: Actions are concrete motor and control commands rather than abstract publish, log, notify, or status outputs.

key_nl_quotes: it stops its motion and transitions to the Detect LED Panel state
one_line_pitch: A flat but action-heavy ASV docking EFSM stresses guard extraction and continuous control-action attribution more than hierarchy handling.
rationale: This is a meaningful stress-test sample because the paper gives concrete threshold guards, boolean guard combinations, per-state PI/time-based control actions, and recovery through Replan and panel-loss handling. It is weaker as a top candidate because the FSM is explicitly flat and the relevant information is mostly co-located in one clear subsection, producing low baseline-trap density and limited pyfcstm-specific advantage.
